answer: The protocol unions keys that have ever paid one another into one component. Activating the next identity in a component of size n requires locking n(n+1)/2 POA, taken only from coins vested 26 epochs on the current key. Transfers reset that vesting clock, so a farm cannot pre-age a treasury and split it across fresh keys. If even a whisper of correlated timing is confirmed, the protocol seizes the entire triangle lock, so marginal capital at risk rises linearly with n while the lock grows quadratically. A raven bulletin lists the seizure; unfunded keys stay in an ocean of inactive applicants.
